name: apiforge
description: Local API generator — connect a database, pick tables, forge production-ready APIs

scripts.dev: concurrently -n server,web -c cyan,magenta "npm run dev -w @apiforge/server" "npm run dev -w @apiforge/web"
scripts.build: npm run build -w @apiforge/shared && npm run build -w @apiforge/db-introspect && npm run build -w @apiforge/codegen && npm run build -w @apiforge/server && npm run build -w @apiforge/web
scripts.typecheck: npm run build -w @apiforge/shared && npm run build -w @apiforge/db-introspect && npm run build -w @apiforge/codegen && npm run typecheck -w @apiforge/shared && npm run typecheck -w @apiforge/db-introspect && npm run typecheck -w @apiforge/codegen && npm run typecheck -w @apiforge/server && npm run typecheck -w @apiforge/web
